text_block_list.text:
What incredible strength! Нарита Брайан
wins the
Kikuka Sho!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
And the crowd goes wild! The Kyoto
Racecourse
erupts in celebration!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I was able to win the Kikuka Sho
with no
problems.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: You've really come a long way.

text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I think so too. This past
year—no, ever
since my debut...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Now, hooold on just a minute!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
This is no time to be wrappin' things up!
What are
you two thinkin'?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That's right, it's me! Now, come over
here a sec,
would ya.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
So, the time has come for us to fulfill
that
promise. Eh, Brian?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You didn't come all this way just so we
could pat
each other on the back and
call it quits, didja?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Of course not. This level of success is
hardly
enough to satisfy me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: So I'll see you in the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан comes back to the waiting
room with
some pep in her step, looking
quite pleased.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
